claim_type: realizability of an explicit discrete measure
limitations: Disproof assumes the standard fact that a full-dimensional centroid-at-origin polytope contains the origin in its interior; it does not address non-polytopal bodies, other centers, or the general discrete logarithmic Minkowski problem beyond this six-atom measure.
provenance: Previously published finding; fresh independent assessment pending.
record_title: Non-realizability of an explicit six-atom cone-volume measure with centroid at the origin
